payload.title: Flaky CI on main: cold-start tsx subprocess tests exceed vitest 5s default
payload.description: apps/cli + apps/server package-entry suites spawn the CLI/server entry via a cold 'pnpm exec tsx' per test. On loaded CI runners a single cold start exceeds vitest's 5s default, so pull_request runs (quiet runner) passed while push-to-main runs went red intermittently. Fix: global testTimeout/hookTimeout=30s in vitest.config.ts (+ widened package-entry execFile timeouts). A genuinely hung process still trips 30s.
